title: An adopted subscription’s update is never auto-accepted
rationale: Subscription updates do not count against proposalFrequency and may be surfaced under any policy, so the frequency budget is not what withholds auto-acceptance here — the impact class is. An adopted subscription’s update is classified major by Section 4, and major is above every ceiling the protocol can express.

requirement.text: Because they are classified at least minor (Section 4), an adopted subscription’s update (major) can never be auto-accepted.
